motion.notes: Header ring pill advances by season on scroll (1440-scroll-25/50/75.jpg); sun travels an arc lighting build steps in order (1440-scroll-50.jpg vs 1440-rm-full.jpg); drag compare plate, verdict counter ring. -0.5 19 data-reveal plus 8 stagger suggest uniform entrances; hero dial static in every frame, no single retellable moment.

wow.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg hail band: ground-check checklist gives a verdict card in signature language (0-of-5 ring, mono header, CTA, Print this check), tied to the hail thesis; plus the season ring moving in the header. Not 10: tool output and hero ring are not connected.

polish.notes: Designed footer close with ring mark and tagline, consistent radius and rules (1440-full.jpg). -0.5 'Sample reviews' tag floats unaligned next to reviews h2, and the stretched form panel is half empty (1440-full.jpg).

elevate.move: Make the hero dial the scroll engine: the gold marker rotates through the five seasons in step with the season bands, town dots pulse when their season's work is mentioned, and the header pill becomes a miniature of the same dial, so 'the year turns as you scroll' is the one motion idea (static current-month ring in reduced motion).

Rebuild the service index as an almanac table on the 120-1320 grid: 9 job rows against 12 month columns with gold bars where each job peaks, and set the price list on the same month grid as a quieter second table, so the lower third shares the season geometry and the featured-card void disappears.
